run_optimized_execution: run the optimized_execution context manager to control JIT executor optimization
test_fuser_context: test the fuser context manager to switch between backend fusers like fuser0, fuser1, fuser2, fuser3, or none
build_fusion_strategy: build a fusion strategy list to set the type and number of specializations during JIT fusion
get_graph_for_module: get the optimized JIT graph for a scripted module with given input arguments
summarize_differentiable_nodes: summarize the _get_differentiable_graph_node function that recursively collects differentiable graph nodes
